prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Lorena, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Lorena thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is finally cracking down and will be issuing heavy fines to anyone who leaves bins on the sidewalk for even a minute past 8am. It’s about time they stopped this neighborhood eyesore once and for all!"
text: The council is launching an aggressive crackdown and will be slapping us with massive fines for leaving bins out even for a second. They’re finally turning our street into a police state just to enforce their ridiculous new rules.
